requirements.description: Alphabet FY2025 10-K: original text and tables disclosing 2025 share repurchase amounts (Class A and Class C shares repurchased, aggregate amounts), the remaining repurchase authorization, and the footnotes stating which costs the amounts include or exclude (e.g., excise tax, transaction costs).
